verdict.rationale: Polar documents an automated dunning flow: failed charges move subscriptions to `past_due`, stamp `past_due_at` and `next_payment_attempt_at`, retry on a fixed 2/5/7/7-day schedule, and email customers a portal link. An agent can observe this through webhooks, the Customer State API, and the OAuth MCP server with subscription and order actions. Retries and outreach are Polar-driven on a fixed schedule rather than agent-controlled. Off-session charges against saved payment methods only imply a manual retry path. missing for 10: documented failed-payment webhook event types, an API to trigger or reschedule retries, agent-controllable or customizable dunning outreach, independent hands-on corroboration.
